learning_objective: 🎯 We will learn about the fun traditional game of Lagori and the joy of playing sports together!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Lagori is a very fun team game played with a soft ball and a pile of seven flat stones. It is an exciting outdoor game that many children love.
To win the game teams have to run fast aim well and work together. Playing sports teaches us how to be a good team player and share joy.

fun_activity.title: ⚽ Target Practice
fun_activity.instructions: Stack three empty plastic cups and try to knock them down by rolling a soft ball from a distance with your friends!

quick_recap: ⭐ Lagori is an exciting traditional game played with stones and a ball.
⭐ We need focus speed and teamwork to win games.
⭐ Playing sports keeps us active healthy and very happy.
